root.label: Kyiv bridges partially closed after Russian strikes

events.label: Kyiv bridges partially closed after Russian strikes

slots.name: bridges closed
slots.sentence: The Russian strikes forcing the full or partial closure of three of Kyiv’s six road bridges caused traffic logjams

slots.name: bridges hit
slots.sentence: One of the three bridges was hit again on Friday afternoon, Mayor Vitalii Klitschko said.

slots.name: travel status
slots.sentence: Attacks on the Southern Bridge have caused major travel disruption since Thursday, with metro and car travel across it suspended.

slots.name: city population
slots.sentence: Many of the city's residents - which number about three million - rely on the metro to travel across the city.

events.label: Russian strike on Northern Bridge in Kyiv

slots.name: traffic status
slots.sentence: The attack on Saturday morning damaged the road surface and trolleybus overhead wires on the Northern (Pivnichnyi) Bridge, Klitschko said, causing traffic to be blocked.

slots.name: capital residents
slots.sentence: The intensifying campaign has upended life for the capital's 3 million residents ahead of the bitter winter months.

slots.name: attack date
slots.sentence: Russia has recently escalated strikes on infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital, hitting a bridge across the Dnipro river in an air attack on Saturday.
